hero.title: LS is a personal AI operating layer for agents that should work in your logic, your rhythm, and your quality.
hero.subtitle: Connect any model or agent, then run its output through LS for memory, shaping, repair, coordination, and harmonic diagnostics before it reaches you.

problem.title: From raw agents to a personal intelligence layer

items.centralized: Raw agents pull you into their defaults instead of adapting to your standards.
items.size: A bigger model is still the wrong layer when what you need is continuity, shaping, and control.
items.hallucinations: Fast output without review can inject weak reasoning straight into your workflow.
items.memory: Most assistants forget your context the moment you switch models, tools, or sessions.

problem.solutionBody: LS sits between you and every agent: it keeps continuity, shapes weak output, catches tension and drift, and turns disconnected models into one reviewable system around you.

features.title: What LS adds between you and AI

local.title: Local Control
local.desc: Operational context stays under your control instead of disappearing into a hosted black box.

causal.title: Continuity Memory
causal.desc: Keeps continuity across agents, sessions, and decisions instead of resetting every time you switch tools.

human.title: Your Standards First
human.desc: LS lets agents adapt to your intent instead of forcing you to adapt to theirs.

anti.title: Response Shaping
anti.desc: Weak or risky output can be surfaced, reshaped, repaired, or held before it reaches you.

identity.title: Personal Cognitive Layer
identity.desc: The system learns your rhythm, preferred tone, and what counts as a good answer for you.

cta.title: Run agents through your own system before they reach you

runtime.title: An operating system for personal AI control

problem.title: Problem
problem.body: AI outputs often arrive raw. Once an agent is already moving, it becomes hard to explain, verify, and correct what is happening.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: LS adds a control loop between you and every agent: reflect -> review -> shape, approve, reject, repair, or hold.

runtimeLive.title: Runtime Live Panel
runtimeLive.offlineNote: Local demo data is shown because the reflection backend is offline. The panel remains interactive so the operator flow stays visible on a static landing.
